page.title: Your week
page.purpose: Show whether this week's plan fits real life: a seven-day board of meal slots on wide screens and a day agenda on phones, with Nutrition and Time & cost views over the same occurrences, linked leftovers and prep, and a reviewable Plan my week.

priorities.statement: Each day's planned meals by slot are readable at a glance; empty slots offer Add and intentionally open slots say so.
Plan my week is the primary action and always previews changes to unlocked future slots before applying.
Meals, Nutrition, and Time & cost show the same date range and occurrences; only the lens changes.
Leftovers and shared prep link both sides, such as For Tue lunch and From Mon, and never duplicate shopping or cooking.
Summary values name their scope and missing data; a day counts as planned only when its required slots are assigned or intentionally open.
On phones the week reads as a day agenda with an All week alternative, never a shrunken seven-column grid.

states.description: The Meals view of the current local week with persisted occurrences.
First read of the page's data; stable skeletons reserve the layout so nothing shifts on arrival, and no sample food is shown as saved data.
Some contributing data is unknown or could not be read; what is missing is named rather than shown as zero.
Displayed data is older than its freshness window; its age is shown next to it.
A write is in flight; the affected control shows a busy state and says why it is unavailable, and success appears only after the durable save.
The request failed; the reason and the next action are stated, pending edits are kept, and nothing is edited against a fake empty account.
The client cannot reach the API; cached data, locally pending actions, and server-confirmed saves are distinguished and unsupported actions say why.
Nothing is planned for this week; Plan my week and Add a meal are offered, and empty slots are not counted as planned.
The Nutrition view: per-day target summaries with scope, bounds, and completeness over the same occurrences.
The Time & cost view: active and elapsed time, shared prep counted once, portion cost versus checkout with coverage.
The phone All week display: seven compact day sections with meal titles.
An occurrence panel (a sheet on phones) with recipe summary, nutrition, ingredients, notes, and actions.
Move is choosing a date and slot; an occupied target asks whether to swap, add alongside, or replace.
Plan my week produced a preview listing changed, unchanged, and locked slots with a before-and-after summary.
The preview's inputs changed after it was generated; it is revalidated instead of applied.
Moving or removing a producing meal would strand a leftover; affected consumers are previewed with a repair.

claims.statement: Plan my week is the one visually dominant action; Review groceries is a secondary link.
Switching between Meals, Nutrition, and Time & cost keeps the same date range and occurrences.
On phones the week is a day selector, a Day or All week toggle, and stacked slot cards, never seven narrow columns.
The board appears only when each day gets a readable width; otherwise the agenda is used and the page never scrolls sideways.
Every move or copy available by dragging is also available through Move and the occurrence panel.
Moving onto an occupied slot asks whether to swap, add alongside, or replace; nothing is destroyed by an accidental drop.
A leftover shows For on its producer and From on its consumer, and each links to the other.
Plan my week never changes the plan without a preview that lists changed, unchanged, and locked slots.
A preview whose inputs changed is revalidated rather than applied.
An unknown duration reads Time not set and never 0 min.
An intentionally open slot is labelled differently from an unassigned slot and contributes unknown intake, not zero.
Summary counts name their scope; one dinner never makes a day fully planned.
Week navigation, the view selector, every slot card, Add actions, Move, and Plan my week are keyboard reachable.
Light and Evening change palette and artwork only; the recipe, servings, dates, occurrences, layout, and actions are identical.
